name: AI Block
description: Provides a block with simple AI features.
project_description: AI Block adds a single configurable Drupal block plugin (id ai_block, admin label "AI Block") whose body is the text response of an AI chat prompt. An editor places the block, types a prompt, and optionally picks which AI provider/model to use; on render the module runs the prompt through the AI module's chat abstraction and prints the returned text through a Twig template. The prompt supports core token replacement (node and user tokens) and two alter hooks let other modules rewrite the prompt or the response. It depends on core block and config and on the contrib AI module (drupal/ai) for provider access; a default chat provider must be configured in the AI module. Supports Drupal 10 and 11.
